question: Where can I get the planned new power lines and substations in the United States, with location, voltage, planned date and status?

answer.summary: PJM's live XML, CAISO's annual plan and status workbooks, and MISO's MTEP package list regional upgrades and give project descriptions, status and estimated in-service dates. The sources checked give locations by name, state or occasional point. No downloadable route geometry or national dataset was verified. Filter out equipment-only, canceled and completed work when looking for new lines and substations.
main_caveats: No national list was found: PJM, CAISO and MISO were read, ERCOT was blocked (403), ISO-NE only via a PDF update, and NYISO, SPP, BPA and individual utilities were not opened.
Files give names and state, not routes: only 16 of 15,816 PJM rows embed a coordinate; CAISO and MISO give substation names and text; CAISO route maps are images in the plan.
The 19 Nov 2026 PJM snapshot had 15,816 upgrades and 5,637 pending or active records. Filter out breakers, relays, reconductoring and other work outside the scope of new lines and substations.
Listing or approval is not construction: PJM Board approval, MISO 'Appendix A Approved' and CAISO plan approval precede permits; expected in-service dates are revised often.
Versions change under one URL: CAISO's main plan URL now serves the 2026-08-27 update, MISO's MTEP26 package is a draft, and PJM's XML is overwritten in place.
answer.confidence_reason: Three operators downloaded and parsed; ERCOT blocked, ISO-NE partial, NYISO, SPP, BPA unopened. Claims are limited to the operators read; no route data was found.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o projectCostUpgrades.xml 'https://www.pjm.com/pjmfiles/media/planning/projectConstruction-data/projectCostUpgrades.xml' ; parse each <Upgrade>, keep Status in (PL, EP, UC, UC-ISP, Active, On Hold) and Equipment in ('Transmission Line', 'Substation')
how_to_use.example_result: UpgradeId b3780.2: 'Peach Bottom to Graceton (PECO) - New 500 kV transmission line', Voltage 500, State PA, Status UC, ProjectedInServiceDate 10/23/2028, PJMBoardApprovalDate 7/12/2023, TransmissionOwner PECO, LastUpdated 11/4/2026.
steps: Download the XML (25.8 MB on 2026-11-19) and parse every Upgrade element into a row; 15,816 rows, all UpgradeIds distinct.
Keep pending work: Status PL, EP, UC, UC-ISP, Active or On Hold (5,637 rows); of these 1,608 are Equipment 'Transmission Line' and 900 'Substation'.
Read Description to tell a new line or substation from a rebuild, reconductor, breaker or transformer upgrade: Equipment alone does not say.
Use ProjectedInServiceDate, or RevisedInServiceDate when present (2,286 rows), as the expected date; PJMBoardApprovalDate is the approval date.
Location: use the text and State; 16 rows carry a '(lat,lon)' pair inside Location (e.g. 'Mountaineer--(38.9761,-81.9418)-{GUID}').
reading_traps: Status codes: IS in service 9,326; EP engineering and procurement 3,848; Cancelled 847; Active 812 (queue-linked network upgrades with no interconnection agreement yet); UC under construction 607; On Hold 226; PL 132; UC-ISP 12; W 6.
The table mixes projects and parts: b3847.1, b3847.2 and b3847.3 are single 765 kV breakers; a new line is usually one row among many sharing a b-number prefix.
Date typos exist: one ProjectedInServiceDate is in 1905 and one LatestTEACDate in 2205; Voltage is blank in 308 pending rows.
The XLS linked as 'Latest TCIC version' is 'As of 7.11.2023' (38 MB, last modified 2023-07-12); use the XML for current data.
A Baseline or Supplemental upgrade at an existing substation is not a new substation; Supplemental upgrades are owner-driven (6,763 rows).

problems: The page's 'Latest TCIC version' XLS is a 2023 snapshot (last modified 2023-07-12).
